tests.title: Kiosk order WITHOUT payment selection
tests.expected: On Valider, kiosk skips payment-method picker, auto-submits as PAY_AT_COUNTER, navigates to confirmation/waiting screen with queue number + 'Veuillez payer à la caisse'.
tests.observed: Plan B branch is unreachable from the UI. payAtCounterOnly computed property returns false because window.foodkingConfig.kioskPayAtCounterOnly is undefined/null. The original v-if='!submitting && !submitted' still renders the TPE method grid; mounted() hook does NOT call confirmPayment('counter') because payAtCounterOnly === false.
root_cause_evidence: git diff f36c84c11..HEAD -- resources/views/master.blade.php → the kioskPayAtCounterOnly: @json(...) line added by f36c84c11 (line 95) is GONE in HEAD
Likely reverting commit: f485f5e4a (chore: snapshot working-tree state pre-bundle-rebuild) — last toucher of master.blade.php per git log -5
Empirical: page.evaluate(() => window.foodkingConfig.kioskPayAtCounterOnly) returned undefined/null at /kiosk/idle on http://127.0.0.1:8000
Plus secondary: .env has no KIOSK_PAY_AT_COUNTER_ONLY=true line — even if master.blade.php were restored, config('kiosk.pay_at_counter_only') would still be false.
